summary: Frontend-only testing of 'House of Kriyā' landing page. All required data-testid elements are present and visible; hero, context, status (3 items), philosophy, CTA, and footer content match the spec; Devanagari accent क्रिया renders; background is soft beige rgb(247,245,240); CTA href starts with mailto:ansh@houseofkriya.com; footer email href = mailto:ansh@houseofkriya.com; no horizontal scroll on 375x812 mobile; no console errors captured; all 9 data-reveal elements become visible during natural scroll-through.
critical_code_review_comments: Scroll reveal uses IntersectionObserver with rootMargin '0px 0px -40px 0px' and threshold 0.15 — works correctly with natural scrolling; an instant scrollTo(bottom) can skip intermediate reveals (not a real-user issue, just a test nuance).
Landing.jsx is a single 308-line file — acceptable for a one-page landing; if more sections are added, consider splitting Nav/Hero/Context/Status/Philosophy/CTA/Footer into separate files.
The 'Made with Emergent' dev badge overlaps the footer email on some viewports (it's the emergent preview wrapper, not app code).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure static landing page. All required data-testids verified (landing-page, hero-title, hero-subtitle, devanagari-accent, context-headline, context-body, status-heading, status-item-1..3, philosophy-line-1/2, cta-headline, cta-build-button, footer-brand, footer-email). CTA mailto and footer mailto both resolve correctly. No backend involved.
